017package org.apache.juneau.commons.conversion;
018
019import java.util.*;
020import java.util.function.*;
021
022/**
023 * A {@link BasicConverter} subclass that supports pluggable type conversion discovery via {@link ConversionFinder}.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * Pass one or more {@link ConversionFinder} instances to the constructor. Finders are consulted in order before
027 * falling back to the built-in {@link BasicConverter} reflection logic.
028 *
029 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
030 * <p class='bjava'>
031 *    ConfigurableConverter <jv>converter</jv> = <jk>new</jk> ConfigurableConverter(
032 *       (<jv>in</jv>, <jv>out</jv>) -> <jv>in</jv> == String.<jk>class</jk> &amp;&amp; <jv>out</jv> == MyBean.<jk>class</jk>
033 *          ? (<jv>s</jv>, <jv>memberOf</jv>, <jv>session</jv>, <jv>args</jv>) -> MyBean.fromString((<jk>String</jk>) <jv>s</jv>)
034 *          : <jk>null</jk>
035 *    );
036 *
037 *    MyBean <jv>bean</jv> = <jv>converter</jv>.to(<js>"value"</js>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
038 * </p>
039 *
040 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
041 *    <li class='jc'>{@link BasicConverter}
042 *    <li class='jc'>{@link ConversionFinder}
043 *    <li class='jc'>{@link Conversion}
044 * </ul>
045 */
046public class ConfigurableConverter extends BasicConverter {
047
048   private final List<ConversionFinder> finders;
049
050   /**
051    * Constructor.
052    *
053    * @param finders Optional {@link ConversionFinder} instances consulted in order before registered
054    *   type-pair conversions and the built-in {@link BasicConverter} reflection logic.
055    */
056   public ConfigurableConverter(ConversionFinder... finders) {
057      this(null, finders);
058   }
059
060   /**
061    * Constructor.
062    *
063    * @param classNameGuard
064    *    Vets class names before a <c>String</c> is converted to a {@link Class}.
065    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (all names allowed).
066    * @param finders Optional {@link ConversionFinder} instances consulted in order before registered
067    *   type-pair conversions and the built-in {@link BasicConverter} reflection logic.
068    */
069   public ConfigurableConverter(Predicate<String> classNameGuard, ConversionFinder... finders) {
070      super(classNameGuard);
071      this.finders = List.of(finders);
072   }
073
074   /**
075    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if any registered {@link ConversionFinder} can convert the specified type pair.
076    *
077    * <p>
078    * This only checks the registered finders, not the built-in {@link BasicConverter} reflection logic.
079    *
080    * @param inType The input type class.
081    * @param outType The output type class.
082    * @return <jk>true</jk> if a finder-provided conversion exists for the specified type pair.
083    */
084   public boolean hasCustomConversion(Class<?> inType, Class<?> outType) {
085      for (var finder : finders)
086         if (finder.findConversion(inType, outType) != null)
087            return true;
088      return false;
089   }
090
091   @Override
092   @SuppressWarnings({
093      "unchecked" // Type safety guaranteed by ConversionFinder contract
094   })
095   protected <I,O> Conversion<I,O> findConversion(Class<I> inType, Class<O> outType) {
096      for (var finder : finders) {
097         var fn = (Conversion<I,O>) finder.findConversion(inType, outType);
098         if (fn != null)
099            return fn;
100      }
101      return super.findConversion(inType, outType);
102   }
103}
